title: NYC Mayor-Elect Meets Satmar
body: New York City Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani attended Satmar Chof Alef Kislev celebrations, marking a notable moment in his outreach to the Chassidic Jewish community in New York. He visited the Satmar Rebbe of Kiryas Yoel, Rav Aharon Teitelbaum, at the Waterfront.
